scope: Independent archived endpoint and paginated document-table enumeration audit; no document content screening credit.
method: Independently parsed all 14 archived portal documents components, reconstructed every returned table row URL/date-label/type in order, checked all ten-offset increments and the final published no-results template. Compared reconstructed sequences with the saved manifest. No download or mutation of original sources.
disposition: Supports bounded published document-index enumeration and explicit closure states; no required correction.
limits: These rows include agendas, minutes, official documents and correspondence, not just external submissions.
Index publication date is not verified submission, recipient or author date; window eligibility and authored-version deduplication remain separate.
No embedded document table on two portals is an access/enumeration limit, not proof that those committees have no public submissions.
The audit does not establish national completeness or authenticate historical public availability as of October 24.
Repetition of a resource across committees or publication rows may require later deduplication; row count is not a unique external-submission count.
